Subject: Qualification: PoC deployment mode & trial plan - ACME Corp

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the deployment-mode decision so we can scope a PoC that proves the right areas for ACME: 

Recap of needs: 
- Compliance requirement: SOC 2 + customer data isolation (finance/transactions team)
- Latency target: 95th pct under 200ms for query workloads
- Throughput: ~15 reqs/sec with bursts to 50 for peak reporting jobs
- Preference: leaning toward Dedicated capacity or Private VPC depending on audit evidence and timeline

Proposed PoC approach (high level):
1) Week 0: alignment + kickoff with ACME infra and security (stakeholders below)
2) Week 1-2: spin up Dedicated pool (optionally a Private VPC trial if needed), onboard sample model and integration with your staging environment
3) Week 3: validate success criteria (latency, throughput, data access controls, logging/audit)
4) Week 4: review results and recommend production deployment path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Success criteria (suggested, please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for 1k token prompts
- Throughput: sustained 15 reqs/sec with sub-2s tail latency for interactive flows
- Security/compliance: evidence of audit logs + KMS integration for keys used in PoC
- Functional: parity on model outputs for key prompts (we'll provide an eval set)

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred deployment modes to evaluate (Dedicated, Private VPC, or both)
- Provide list of stakeholders to include in kickoff (security, infra, product)
- I will attach a one-page PoC plan and a required-doc checklist for SOC2 items

Attaching: ACME_PoC_Plan_v1.pdf (PoC timeline & checklist)

I can be flexible on timeline — if you want to start next week we can reserve a Dedicated slot. Looping in Jordan for pricing/commit guidance.

Best,
Ben

- Deployment mode: our security team prefers Private VPC, but product/ops want to evaluate Dedicated first for speed of setup. So likely we want a short Dedicated PoC followed by validation on Private VPC if Dedicated meets the perf goals.
- Stakeholders for kickoff: Emily Chen (you know me), Raj Patel (Head of Infrastructure), Victor Alvarez (Security lead), plus a member of our Data Privacy team (TBD).
- Timeline: target kickoff week of Mar 9; can we do a 3-week PoC with a short follow-up?
